high_level_description: The image shows a person standing outdoors on a wooden deck under a thatched roof structure. The individual is wearing a purple bikini and appears to be adjusting the strings of the bikini bottoms. They have shoulder-length hair and are accessorized with a chunky necklace and bracelets. In the background, there is a blue table with some items on it, including what looks like a towel or cloth and possibly a bag. There is also a red sign partially visible behind the table, though the text on it is not fully legible.
